result.title: Mask-Pattern Position Augmentation: Training-Free Long-Context Extrapolation for Diffusion LLMs
result.summary: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) generate by iteratively unmasking tokens with bidirectional attention, but rotary position embeddings (RoPE) still confine them to a fixed pretraining window. Existing training-free extrapolation, notably LongLLaDA, copies NTK-based RoPE scaling from autoregressive (AR) models and applies one static, length-only transform at every position and denoising step. That transplant ignores a signal unique to dLLMs: the evolving mask pattern of the partially decoded sequence. We propose Mask-Pattern Position Augmentation (MPPA). MPPA linearly interpolates indices into the pretrained window, then adds a per-position, per-step offset from cumulative mask density. The offset restores rotary phase resolution that interpolation collapses, and it shrinks as tokens are committed, so late steps see near-clean interpolated geometry. On LLaDA-8B-Instruct at twice its 4096-token window, MPPA reduces perplexity from 19.51 under standard decoding to 3.12 at 8192 tokens, below the in-window figure, with 100% passkey retrieval and unchanged needle-in-a-haystack accuracy. These preliminary $2\times$ results motivate mask-conditioned position engineering as a diffusion-native path to long-context generation.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 MPPA，一种面向 diffusion LLM 的免训练长上下文外推方法：先将 RoPE 索引线性插值进预训练窗口，再依据累积掩码密度为每个位置、每个去噪步添加偏移，使相位分辨率随 token 确定而收敛，并在 LLaDA-8B-Instruct 上报告 2 倍窗口下的困惑度与检索结果。
AI.relevance_reason: 纯文本 dLLM 的位置编码工程，与视觉推理无直接联系；但“按去噪步与解码状态调节注意力相位几何”可供核查 diffusion/并行生成路径下 latent 状态的位置、深度效应及长序列长度泛化线索。
